0.text: After 3 months of development, we are pleased to present WaifuFactory v0.1.0. This release includes 21 worlds to explore and lots of other content. Thank you for playing!

1.text: I'm incredibly happy that so many people enjoyed the game! This inspired me to create a new update with many bug fixes and various additions that players requested. Thank you all for your love and support, see you in the new updates!

2.text: This is a minor update that does not add anything new. It fixes a serious bug that caused characters to fly apart when interacting with them at low FPS.

3.text: We have completed the v0.3.0 update and added a quest system at the request of most players. Now our project has a new opportunity to earn money by completing various tasks. Quests become more difficult as you progress in the game.

4.text: Update v0.4.0 is our biggest update yet. We’ve completely rewritten the game and optimized everything we could. The gameplay has been completely revamped, and there are lots of new features. We can’t wait for you to try the new version!
